Sant Pere, Santa Caterina i la Ribera — Barcelona, Spain

🟡 Local press research

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

This barri (which includes El Born) shows comparatively little press evidence of daytime crime concern — an older ElNacional overview of Ciutat Vella (2018) rated it as having 'fewer problems' than Raval, Gòtic or Barceloneta. A recent MetropoliAbierta report (Jan 2026) on Passeig del Born documents a real night-time issue: sound levels chronically over legal limits, the highest complaint density in Ciutat Vella, and city officials explicitly linking late-night alcohol/drug use around the bars to 'more robberies, arguments and fights,' prompting a new Special Acoustic Regulation Zone. No violent no-go-area pattern was found for daytime; the concern is specifically nightlife-hours disorder around Born's bar strip. Sources checked: MetropoliAbierta, Jan 2026; ElNacional, 2018.
